lineChart.frame: y axis x≈250 from y 245 to 893; x axis y≈893 from x 250 to 1740; ink 3 px; both draw on with the page (4 frames each)
lineChart.ticks: tiny grey typewriter labels under the baseline, fade in over ~10 frames
lineChart.line: red #D2251D 4-5 px, drawn by progress along the data (not by dash), ease-in-out over ~48 frames
lineChart.tip: red dot (10 px) plus a black rounded chip above with white Anton year (current x value), updates every shown frame
lineChart.referenceRule: dashed grey line across with Anton label ($20 TRILLION ink at left, $40 TRILLION red)
lineChart.events: typewriter caps label on a thin grey tick rising from the curve; appears when the tip passes
lineChart.bracket: thin bracket under the axis between two x values with end labels and a white tag in the middle ('• over 2 centuries'); red variant for the second segment
lineChart.rescale: to zoom into a sub-range, events and bracket fade (5 frames), then x and y domains animate ease-in-out over ~15 frames; the drawn line re-maps live

verticalBars.look: torn-paper bars (red for the subject, ink for the comparison), width ~220 px, baseline ink line y≈875; object cutout rides on top; typewriter label under the baseline
verticalBars.grow: from baseline up over ~8 frames ease-out with ~6 px overshoot; second bar starts ~25 frames later on its narration word

horizontalBars.look: torn-paper bars height ~80 px, pitch 140 px, start x≈526; white-outline round icon and white tiny typewriter label at the left inside the bar
horizontalBars.grow: left -> right over 8-10 frames ease-out, stagger 3-4 frames; subject bar is red and waits for its narration word
horizontalBars.reorder: subject bar lifts (scale 1.04) and moves to slot 1 over ~12 frames ease-in-out while the others shift down one slot

budgetCard.look: white torn-edge card #F7F3EB, drop shadow, typewriter title + right-aligned small caption, rows with leader lines and grey placeholder bars; subject row red
budgetCard.entry: slides up from below with ease-out over ~9 frames, tilt -3° -> -1°
budgetCard.value: row value revealed left -> right (clip wipe ~24 frames) in Anton
budgetCard.move: slides left to make room for a chart over ~11 frames ease-out
